title: Binary promise problem
statement: A binary promise problem consists of a set of Boolean strings designated as yes-instances and a set designated as no-instances, with the two sets disjoint. Strings outside these sets need not have either designation.
hypotheses_covered: Yes-instances form a language of Boolean strings
No-instances form a language of Boolean strings
The yes- and no-instance sets are disjoint
